During D-zone clears I had been hit by Pollux's exalt triggering a death resistance. At the start of the next turn, GLotan's pursuit triggered. After dying and returning to that turn from the start of the battle, GLotan's Long Blade and Short Blade were incorrectly hitting 1 and 3 times respectively. With Rouse active it is expected that the cards deal 2 and 4 hits. 

Time rewind to the turn before which did not begin with a pursuit restored the Rouse and I could return to the 5th turn normally. But I suspect Time Rewind to any turn that began with a Pursuit is what causes this error.

It is not just a visual bug on the card description. The attack animation and damage numbers were (incorrectly) 1 and 3 hits.
